# Connect Your Research Community with RDA
This site is a starting point for connecting domain communities with the [Research Data Alliance (RDA)](https://www.rd-alliance.org/), FAIR data practices, and practical resources that support data sharing and reuse.

[Explore Resources](pages/resources/index.qmd){.btn .btn-light .btn-lg .mt-3}
:::

## Why This Site Matters

RDA ambassadors help bridge the gap between the global RDA community and domain-specific research practice. They support awareness of RDA outputs, connect communities with relevant expertise, and help translate FAIR and open science approaches into disciplinary contexts.

## Start Here

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### I am looking for support
- Explore domain-relevant materials in the [Resource Library](pages/resources/index.qmd)
- Find the right contact in the [Ambassadors Directory](pages/ambassadors/index.qmd)
- Learn the context and purpose of the initiative on the [About page](about.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### I want to contribute
- Suggest a new resource, case study, or guide
- Share an ambassador profile or update an existing one
- Submit community news, events, or opportunities relevant to RDA and FAIR data
:::
:::

## What You Can Build Here

- A visible entry point for your local or thematic RDA ambassador activity
- A curated resource hub organized by domain, topic, and format
- A public directory of ambassadors with expertise, affiliations, and contact routes
- A lightweight channel for community news, events, and calls to action

## Suggested Next Content

- Featured resources for 3 to 5 priority domains
- Ambassador profiles with institution, country, expertise, and links
- A short explanation of how this initiative connects to the wider RDA ecosystem
- A first set of events, webinars, or recent updates
